entities.name: Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
entities.description: An Eldrazi horror formed by melding the archangels Bruna and Gisela during the Emrakul incursion.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: Archangel of Innistrad who fell under Emrakul's influence and melded into Brisela.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: Archangel of Innistrad who fell under Emrakul's influence and melded into Brisela.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose corruption reshaped Innistrad.

entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: The battle where Brisela was defeated.

entities.name: Meld
entities.description: Process that fused Bruna and Gisela.

events.summary: Bruna and Gisela fell under Emrakul's influence.
events.quote: Bruna and Gisela fell under Emrakul’s influence

events.summary: Bruna and Gisela were fused through Meld into Brisela.
events.quote: they were physically fused through a process called Meld

events.summary: Thalia, guided by Saint Traft and aided by Sigarda, defeated Brisela at the Battle of Thraben.
events.quote: Thalia , guided by the spirit of Saint Traft and aided by Sigarda , confronted and defeated the abomination
